faq.what_is_a: Amtraker is a website and app that allows you to track Amtrak trains in real time.
faq.data_source_q: Where does your data come from?
faq.data_source_a: Amtraker pulls its data from multiple sources and and rehosts it on our servers. The list of data providers includes, but is not limited to:
faq.data_source_osm: General Map Data (Streets, Buildings, Cities, etc)
faq.data_source_moynihan: NYP Platform Data (When available - tends to be more accurate than NJT)
faq.dev_a_before_link: Yes! Amtraker's data is available for use for free, as long as you don't spam the API ofc. You can find the API documentation
faq.dev_a_after_link: . Let me know any issues you have with the API by emailing me at

faq.stale_q: What does it mean when the data is stale?
faq.stale_a: When, on average, Amtrak hasn't updated their tracking data for more than 15 minutes, the data is outdated and inaccurate. This is usually due to Amtrak's servers having issues.
faq.not_tracking_a_before_link: Amtraker only shows the data available to it. If Amtrak isn't tracking your train, Amtraker won't be able to either. If the train, for whatever reason, is tracking on the official tracker, but not on Amtraker, please
faq.not_tracking_a_after_link: and I'll look as soon as I can.
faq.icons_q: What do the train icons/colors mean?
faq.icons_a_categories: The colors of the icons are broken down into two categories: active and inactive trains.
faq.icons_a_inactive: Any train that has not yet departed its initial terminal, has arrived at its final station, or has been cancelled is inactive and will be dark grey, as shown below.
faq.icons_a_active: Otherwise, the shade of the train depends on how late it is, from a green for 0% late, to a an orange for 25% late, and a bright red for 100% late, with these percentegaes being of a predetermined threshold (see below) depending on the route length and type.
faq.icons_a_colorblind: To help differentiate the colors for those with deuteranopia and protanopia, I have made the saturation and brightness of the colors go up with the percentage, so while not perfect, there should be some level of differentation between the hues. If you have any feedback/ideas for how I can improve this, please let me know.
faq.icons_a_thresholds: For each route, the maximum lateness threshold largely depends on what type of route it is and who is operating said train.
faq.icons_a_threshold_short: All Via Corridor, Acela, Brightline, and any Amtrak trains <250mi: 60min / 1hr

privacy.heading: Privacy Policy for Amtraker
privacy.intro: This privacy policy applies to the Amtraker app and website (amtraker.com) (hereby referred to as "Application") that was created by Piero Maddaleni (hereby referred to as "Service Provider") as an Open Source service. This service is intended for use "AS IS".
privacy.collection_intro: The Application collects information when you download and use it. This information may include information such as
privacy.collection_ip: Your device's Internet Protocol address (e.g. IP address)
privacy.collection_pages: The pages of the Application that you visit, the time and date of your visit, the time spent on those pages
privacy.collection_time: The time spent on the Application
privacy.collection_os: The operating system you use on your mobile device
privacy.collection_contact: The Service Provider may use the information you provided to contact you for account services, such as password resets, but will not use the data.
privacy.collection_pii: For a better experience, while using the Application, the Service Provider may require you to provide us with certain personally identifiable information, including but not limited to your first and last name, email address, and train trips. The information that the Service Provider request will be retained by them and used as described in this privacy policy.
privacy.log_files_body: Amtraker follows a standard procedure of using log files. These files log visitors when they visit websites. All hosting companies do this and a part of hosting services' analytics. The information collected by log files include internet protocol (IP) addresses, browser type, Internet Service Provider (ISP), date and time stamp, referring/exit pages, and possibly the number of clicks. These are not linked to any information that is personally identifiable. The purpose of the information is for analyzing trends, administering the site, tracking users' movement on the website, and gathering demographic information.
privacy.geolocation_body: Upon consenting to sharing your location, the application may collect your device's location to display on the map. This data does not leave your device.
privacy.third_party_body: Please note that the Application utilizes third-party services that have their own Privacy Policy about handling data. Below are the links to the Privacy Policy of the third-party service providers used by the Application:
privacy.disclosure_intro: The Service Provider may disclose User Provided and Automatically Collected Information:
privacy.disclosure_law: as required by law, such as to comply with a subpoena, or similar legal process;
privacy.disclosure_good_faith: when they believe in good faith that disclosure is necessary to protect their rights, protect your safety or the safety of others, investigate fraud, or respond to a government request;
privacy.disclosure_providers: with their trusted services providers who work on their behalf, do not have an independent use of the information we disclose to them, and have agreed to adhere to the rules set forth in this privacy statement.
privacy.retention_body: The Service Provider will retain User Provided data for as long as you use the Application and for a reasonable time thereafter. If you'd like them to delete User Provided Data that you have provided via the Application, please contact them at amtraker@piemadd.com and they will respond in a reasonable time.
privacy.children_body_1: The Service Provider does not use the Application to knowingly solicit data from or market to children under the age of 13.
privacy.children_body_2: The Application does not address anyone under the age of 13. The Service Provider does not knowingly collect personally identifiable information from children under 13 years of age. In the case the Service Provider discover that a child under 13 has provided personal information, the Service Provider will immediately delete this from their servers. If you are a parent or guardian and you are aware that your child has provided us with personal information, please contact the Service Provider (amtraker@piemadd.com) so that they will be able to take the necessary actions.
privacy.security_body: The Service Provider is concerned about safeguarding the confidentiality of your information. The Service Provider provides physical, electronic, and procedural safeguards to protect information the Service Provider processes and maintains.
privacy.changes_body: This Privacy Policy may be updated from time to time for any reason. The Service Provider will notify you of any changes to the Privacy Policy by updating this page with the new Privacy Policy. You are advised to consult this Privacy Policy regularly for any changes, as continued use is deemed approval of all changes.
privacy.effective_date: This privacy policy is effective as of {date}
privacy.consent_body: By using the Application, you are consenting to the processing of your information as set forth in this Privacy Policy now and as amended by us.
privacy.contact_body: If you have any questions regarding privacy while using the Application, or have questions about the practices, please contact the Service Provider via email at amtraker@piemadd.com.
